description.value: The Keg Richmond South is a well-known steakhouse and bar situated near the Ironwood Complex at Steveston and No. 5 Road. The location features a heated and covered patio, bar, and lounge, and is wheelchair accessible with free car parking on site. Touring cyclists exploring the Steveston dyke network will find it a convenient spot for a full sit-down dinner.
